title: ActivityTypeDef
description:
An activity type definition from JSON type `"activity_type"`.

Defines a player activity (e.g. reading, reloading, crafting) with its verb display text and behavioral flags. Maps directly to the C++ `activity_type` class fields loaded from `activity_type.cpp::load()`.

activity_level.description: Exertion level during this activity (NO_EXERCISE = 0.0 to MAX_EXERCISE).

auto_needs.description: If true, the character will automatically consume from auto-eat/drink zones.

can_resume.description: Whether the activity can be suspended and resumed.

completion_eoc.description: Effect-on-condition to run when the activity completes.

do_turn_eoc.description: Effect-on-condition to run each turn of the activity.

fetch_items_to_zone.description: Whether the activity should fetch items to an associated zone.

ignored_distractions.description: Distraction types that are ignored by default for this activity.

interruptable.description: Whether the activity can be interrupted by distractions.

interruptable_with_kb.description: Whether the activity can be interrupted by keyboard input.

multi_activity.description: Whether this is a multi-activity (runs multiple sub-activities).

refuel_fires.description: If true, the character will refuel an adjacent fire if firewood is nearby.

rooted.description: Whether the character is rooted in place during the activity.

ActivityExertion.description:
Named exertion level applied to an ongoing activity's stamina cost.

CDDA's `activity_level` is a string enum in JSON (e.g. `"NO_EXERCISE"`), interpreted as a multiplier. We model the named level here; the numeric multiplier is derived in the simulation layer.

oneOf.description: Progress measured in real time (independent of character speed).
Progress measured in character move points (speed-dependent).
Progress driven entirely by the do_turn handler or actor.

DistractionType.description: An event that can interrupt an ongoing activity.

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
